title: EarthScience FieldLoggerSegmentDrift

stats.done_summary: Completed scenario 04b. Implemented TWDM computation and QA pipeline in code/run_analysis.py; loaded manifest parameters (epsilon, threshold, segment_report_order, golden_cases), validated golden cases with enforced max abs error ≤1e-9 (details saved to outputs/golden_case_check.csv), computed ordered per-segment TWDM table (outputs/segment_twdm_table.csv), generated a VWC vs frame PNG for the first manifest-ordered segment under report/images/, and wrote the full publication-style report to report/report.md referencing the figure and including the ordered results table plus discussion.
